n03e25857c5.headline: House prices started to rise again in 2023, says Halifax
n03e25857c5.summary: House prices have stopped falling and are rising again, according to a report from mortgage lender Halifax.
n03e25857c5.why: Halifax is one of the UK's largest mortgage lenders, and its house price index is a widely watched gauge of the housing market.

n120834dd27.headline: Immunic, Inc. Announces Private Placement of up to $240 Million
n120834dd27.summary: Biotechnology company Immunic, Inc. announced a private placement of up to $240 million, according to a PRNewswire release dated January 5, 2024.
n120834dd27.why: Immunic is a clinical-stage biotech developing oral small-molecule therapies for chronic inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, and private placements fund its trials.

n2334ac4809.headline: UPDATE 1-World food price index ends 2023 some 10% below 2022 levels | Headlines
n2334ac4809.summary: The FAO food price index averaged 118.5 points in December, down 1.5% from November and 10.1% below a year earlier. For 2023 it averaged 13.7% lower, with only sugar higher.
n2334ac4809.why: The FAO food price index tracks globally traded food commodities and is a key benchmark for global food inflation and agricultural trade.

na511aa775a.headline: Africa's largest cement producer in quest to raise N60bn to finance business
na511aa775a.summary: Dangote Cement has posted two commercial paper series, worth N60.01 billion in total, under its N300 billion issuance programme on the FMDQ Exchange.
na511aa775a.why: Dangote Cement is Africa's largest cement producer, and commercial paper is a short-term debt instrument used to fund working capital.

n566fa8b504.headline: AKTIEN IM FOKUS 2:  Deutsche Bank falls after good run - sector in focus
n566fa8b504.summary: Deutsche Bank shares lost 1.2 percent to 12.37 euros in Frankfurt on Friday after a downgrade by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. The stock traded below the slightly lower level it had reached earlier.
n566fa8b504.why: Deutsche Bank is a large German universal bank with global investment banking and trading operations, so analyst rating changes can move its share price and sector sentiment.

n5c15cb3190.headline: India to sign MoU with Guyana for buying crude oil - OrissaPOST
n5c15cb3190.summary: India's Union Cabinet approved signing a five-year memorandum of understanding with Guyana for cooperation in the hydrocarbon sector, including crude oil purchases.
n5c15cb3190.why: India is one of the world's largest crude oil importers, so long-term supply agreements with producers such as Guyana affect its energy security.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n6100fc5469.headline: Multitude SE Contemplates a Relocation to Switzerland
n6100fc5469.summary: Fintech platform Multitude SE is considering a relocation from Finland to Switzerland while keeping its legal personality. The company says Finnish law would otherwise require a different process.
n6100fc5469.why: Multitude is a listed fintech lender, and changes to its legal domicile can affect its regulation, tax treatment and investor base.

na1fb1189b5.headline: Marico Q3 Update: Revenue drops even as volumes grow in low single-digit
na1fb1189b5.summary: Marico's revenue fell in the December quarter even as volumes grew in the low single digits. The company cut channel partner stock as it worked to improve returns in general trade.
na1fb1189b5.why: Marico is an Indian consumer goods company selling hair care and edible oils, and its quarterly results signal demand and distribution trends in India.

naa61a8037c.headline: This Oil Stock Is Following Leaders ExxonMobil and Occidental Petroleum by Making a Major Acquisition
naa61a8037c.summary: APA Corp is buying Callon Petroleum to strengthen its position in the Permian Basin. The deal targets oil assets in the major US shale region.
naa61a8037c.why: APA is an independent oil and gas producer, and consolidation in the Permian Basin is a major theme among US shale companies seeking scale.

n85f7edfe1b.headline: Naira faces new threat, drops to below N1,200/$ on the black market
n85f7edfe1b.summary: The naira dropped below N1,200 to the dollar on the black market, according to the report. The currency faces a new threat in the unofficial market.
n85f7edfe1b.why: The naira's parallel-market rate is a key gauge of currency stress in Nigeria, affecting import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns.

n1fffe15181.headline: Palm oil gains on expectations of tighter supplies
n1fffe15181.summary: Malaysian palm oil futures rose for a second consecutive session on Friday as investors assessed the outlook for supplies. Prices gained on expectations of tighter supply.
n1fffe15181.why: Palm oil is a major edible oil and biofuel feedstock, and Malaysia is one of the two largest producers, so its futures price influences food and energy costs.

n202ad2e32c.headline: Norwegian offshore service provider scoops up support contract for Brazil FPSO
n202ad2e32c.summary: A Norwegian offshore service provider has won a support contract for a Brazil FPSO vessel. The 15-month contract starts in the second quarter, with an option to extend.
n202ad2e32c.why: FPSO vessels are floating production units used in offshore oil projects, so support contracts reflect ongoing offshore activity.

nf40e6ddf57.headline: Eurozone Inflation Rises To 2.9% In December
nf40e6ddf57.summary: Annual eurozone inflation rose to 2.9% in December, mainly due to energy costs, official data showed on Friday.
nf40e6ddf57.why: Eurozone inflation data shapes European Central Bank interest rate expectations, which affect the euro, government bond yields and equity valuations across the region.
nf40e6ddf57.why_moved: An inflation reading above the prior level, driven by energy costs, can shift expectations for European Central Bank policy and therefore bond yields and the euro.

na97b8d6571.headline: India’s digital currency transactions top 1 million per day in December
na97b8d6571.summary: Indian banks disbursed some employee benefits through the e-rupee in December, helping the Reserve Bank of India meet its target of one million daily transactions by end-2023, sources said.
na97b8d6571.why: The e-rupee is India's central bank digital currency, and its adoption affects payment systems and the central bank's digital currency strategy.

n61d3076659.headline: Can new EU corporate tax rules make big business pay its fair share?
n61d3076659.summary: A landmark global deal setting a minimum 15% corporate tax rate for multinational companies came into force in the European Union on January 1.
n61d3076659.why: The global minimum tax limits the benefit of low-tax jurisdictions, changing effective tax rates and cash flows for large multinational groups.

n41501e904c.headline: As manifesto deadline day looms, five questions Keir Starmer must answer
n41501e904c.summary: Labour must set policy on taxes, green spending and the NHS before its election campaign begins, the Guardian reports. The manifesto deadline is approaching.
n41501e904c.why: Labour leader Keir Starmer's party leads UK polls ahead of an election, and its tax and spending plans shape gilt yields and sterling expectations.

n3c1ba0f629.headline: Ukraine's forex reserves up 42% on 'unprecedented' Western aid in 2023 - Times of India
n3c1ba0f629.summary: Ukraine's foreign exchange reserves grew 42% over the past year to $40.5 billion as of January 1. The article attributes the increase to unprecedented foreign financial aid.
n3c1ba0f629.why: Foreign exchange reserves indicate a central bank's capacity to defend its currency and meet external obligations. Western aid is a key source of Ukraine's external financing.

nbab2f89f40.headline: Ringgit slips further against US dollar
nbab2f89f40.summary: The ringgit slipped further against the US dollar as expectations of higher interest rates for longer are likely to persist.
nbab2f89f40.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its exchange rate reflects interest-rate differentials against the US dollar.

n48f43bc2fe.headline: DWP one month warning as final £299 Cost of Living Payment date nears
n48f43bc2fe.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions is set to send out the third and final Cost of Living Payment of £299, taking total support to £900.
n48f43bc2fe.why: Government cash support payments to households affect consumer spending and the public finances, and are set by the UK Department for Work and Pensions.

ne249721e8f.headline: Senegalese startup Diotali revolutionizes car insurance
ne249721e8f.summary: Senegalese startup Diotali is revolutionizing the car insurance sector through digitalization and partnerships.
ne249721e8f.why: Digital innovation in insurance can improve efficiency and market penetration in Senegal's financial services sector.

nfbee602ec6.headline: Trump’s Bold Border Promise
nfbee602ec6.summary: Former President Trump demonstrated the power of the presidency to impose tariffs without congressional approval, impacting trade policy dynamics.
nfbee602ec6.why: Trade policies and tariffs directly affect international trade flows, tariffs, and related sectors.

na760438b8c.headline: Adani Group founder Gautam Adani is once again Asia's richest person
na760438b8c.summary: Gautam Adani has regained the title of Asia's richest person according to Bloomberg Billionaires Index.
na760438b8c.why: Adani's wealth reflects the performance of his conglomerate, which is involved in infrastructure, energy, and commodities in India and Asia.

nde1db42c98.headline: Singapore stocks snap 2024 losing streak as STI gains 0.3%
nde1db42c98.summary: Singapore's STI rose 0.3%, ending a three-day losing streak and signaling cautious optimism in regional markets.
nde1db42c98.why: Stock index movements reflect investor sentiment and regional economic outlooks, influencing capital flows.

nd42db7c0de.headline: China-Backed Automaker Becomes World's Biggest Seller of Electric Cars
nd42db7c0de.summary: Chinese automaker BYD has overtaken others to become the top global seller of electric vehicles.
nd42db7c0de.why: BYD's leadership in EV sales impacts automotive markets, supply chains, and China's position in clean energy transportation.

n5b86d1df05.headline: Five economic reasons to show Ghana`s problem is Expenditure but not Revenue
n5b86d1df05.summary: Analysis suggests Ghana's economic problems stem from high expenditure rather than revenue shortfalls, with power supply as a key factor.
n5b86d1df05.why: Understanding Ghana's fiscal challenges helps assess its economic stability and investment climate.

n99b4faf1d6.headline: CBN plans to launch stablecoin February 27
n99b4faf1d6.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria plans to launch the cNGN stablecoin on February 27, 2024, after approval.
n99b4faf1d6.why: A central bank digital currency can influence Nigeria's monetary policy, currency stability, and financial inclusion efforts.

n11825c294e.headline: Greek govt spends 20 mn euro to revive 2,300-yr-old palace which hosted Alexander
n11825c294e.summary: Greece invests in restoring the 2,300-year-old Palace of Aigai, a site of global historical importance, with potential tourism and cultural sector implications.
n11825c294e.why: Restoration of historic sites can boost tourism and cultural industries, affecting local economies and related sectors.

n1715f2fb78.headline: Darjeeling tea hits 8-yr low in auctions
n1715f2fb78.summary: Lower demand from export markets and domestic buyers have caused Darjeeling tea prices to fall to their lowest since 2015.
n1715f2fb78.why: Tea prices affect farmers, exporters, and the regional economy of Darjeeling, influencing commodity markets and trade balances.

nd35eabe44d.headline: Military influence and political peril in Pakistan
nd35eabe44d.summary: Pakistan is experiencing economic turmoil, political unrest, and growing concerns about military involvement in politics.
nd35eabe44d.why: Political instability and military influence can undermine economic reforms, foreign investment, and fiscal stability in Pakistan.

n87e1fab1aa.headline: U.S. unemployment has been under 4% for the longest streak since the Vietnam War
n87e1fab1aa.summary: The US labor market added 216,000 jobs in December, with unemployment steady at 3.7%, indicating resilience despite rising interest rates.
n87e1fab1aa.why: Low unemployment and job growth are key indicators of economic health and influence Federal Reserve policy.

n94929b1a7c.headline: Armed forces remain focused on war against insurgency — DHQ
n94929b1a7c.summary: The Nigerian military remains committed to fighting insurgents across the country, according to the Defence Headquarters.
n94929b1a7c.why: Security operations influence regional stability and can impact economic activity in Nigeria.

ncc2c9efca5.headline: Scenes of Loss Play Out Across Japan's Western Coastline After Quake Kills 84, Dozens Still Missing
ncc2c9efca5.summary: A quake in Japan's western coast caused fatalities and damage, with ongoing rescue efforts.
ncc2c9efca5.why: Natural disasters impact local economies, infrastructure, and insurance markets, especially in affected regions.

n9dcb639ec7.headline: IT Minister Gives Good News Regarding PayPal in Pakistan
n9dcb639ec7.summary: The Pakistani government resolved long-standing demands by enabling freelancers to receive remittances through PayPal's international gateway.
n9dcb639ec7.why: Access to PayPal facilitates cross-border payments and supports the growing freelance economy, boosting foreign exchange inflows.
